issues.detail: Assertion 4 is complete:true and requires `^# Technical Design` in the design. The template's literal title is `# Technical Design` and suffixed titles still match, so nearly every correct run passes; a run that retitles it (e.g. `# Customer Preferred Name Design`) would fail. Acceptable given the template is authoritative on shape.
issues.fix: Optionally relax the regex to `^# .*Technical Design|^# Technical Design` or drop it, relying on the Acceptance Coverage heading and provenance.
